name: tubevault-monorepo
description: TubeVault - YouTube Video, Album/Playlist & Channel Downloader (Chrome Extension + Local Node.js Engine + Windows Installer)

scripts.build:engine: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=@tubevault/engine run build && node scripts/build-engine.mjs
scripts.build:ext: npm run build:shared && npm run gen:key && npm --workspace=@tubevault/extension run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run gen:key && npm run build:engine && npm run build:ext && npm run build:launcher
scripts.build:installer: npm run build:all && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-installer.ps1
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@tubevault/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@tubevault/engine run typecheck && npm --workspace=@tubevault/extension run typecheck
